preprocess: Input must already be skeleton keypoints, not raw RGB frames.
Each sample must contain 21 hand joints in the same order as training.
Each joint must provide wrist-relative and scale-normalized x, y, z coordinates.
global_traj must be built from upperbody_wrist_xyz relative to the first valid frame.
The deployed pipeline must keep the same temporal length as the exported model.

extra_inputs.name: global_traj
extra_inputs.definition: upperbody_wrist_xyz[t] - upperbody_wrist_xyz[first_valid], then normalize x by img_w and y by img_h while keeping z raw

postprocess: Take argmax over the class dimension for top-1 prediction.
Map class index to label with hand21_label_mapping.json or hand21_labels.txt.
